Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Quick question from procurement as we kick off the 30-day pilot: our internal policy prefers invoice-only setup for small pilots under $10k to avoid the overhead of issuing POs for each vendor engagement. Can Redwood support an invoice-only onboarding for KiteYard for the upcoming pilot, or do you require a PO up front? If invoice-only is acceptable, what evidence or approvals do you need from our side (insurance, SOC2 excerpts, POA, billing contact)?

We aim to start next Monday. Appreciate a clear list of requirements so I can route approvals quickly.

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and welcome. Short answer: we can make a conditional invoice-only onboarding work for the pilot, with an approval ladder and a small evidence package. Proposed approach below: 

- Threshold: pilots up to $12,000 (total committed value) may follow invoice-only onboarding. Anything above requires a PO on file.
- Evidence required from customer: signed SOW/Order Form, billing contact, proof of company payment details (W-9 / VAT ID), and basic security attestation (SOC2 summary or security questionnaire PDF).
- Approval ladder inside Redwood: Sales approval (AM) -> Sales Ops validation (billing & KYC) -> Finance sign-off for any invoices > $5k single invoice.
- Controls: 30-day pilot duration, prepaid or net30 invoicing per agreed term, and automatic disablement at trial expiry if no PO/contract remains.

I'll loop in Sales Ops and Procurement on our side for a final sign-off and share our PO-waiver template / evidence checklist. If that sounds acceptable, send the billing contact + W-9 and we can generate an invoice/OrderForm today.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Lena's clarifying questions. Need your recommended language for the approval ladder and the expiration logging so I can give KiteYard a firm answer. My suggested defaults: 

- $5k = per single invoice threshold for Finance review (i.e., any invoice > $5k triggers Finance approval prior to booking). Cumulative thresholds governed by the $12k pilot cap.

Hi Lena — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming the approach so you have text to include in your procurement submission: 

1) Thresholds and approvals
- Pilot cap: $12,000 total across the 30-day pilot.
- Invoice review: any single invoice > $5,000 requires Finance sign-off before processing.
- Approval ladder: Account Manager (Sales) -> Sales Ops (billing / KYC) -> Finance (if invoice > $5k). Director of Strategic Accounts (me) is recorded as the Redwood approver for the exception.

2) Evidence required for invoice-only onboarding
- Signed Order Form / SOW (attached: redwood_po-waiver-template.docx)
- Billing contact + W-9 or equivalent (file name: kiteyard_w9.pdf)
- SOC2 attestation or completed security questionnaire (one page ok for pilot)
- Primary billing email and POA if someone else will approve invoices

3) Controls and expiration
- Exception logged in Redwood Procurement Exception Register with expiration set to the pilot end date (30 days from invoice issue).
- If KiteYard converts to a paid plan after the pilot, Redwood will request a PO or established net terms within 15 days of conversion; otherwise billing will require PO going forward.

Next steps for KiteYard to unblock onboarding:
- Send W-9 + billing contact + SOC2 attestation to procurement@redwood.com (or reply to this thread).
- I’ll countersign the exception and we’ll issue a single invoice / Order Form.
- I’ll also create an exception entry and attach the evidence checklist.
